definitions.label: Standard
definitions.description: Best all-around build for a typical game.
definitions.prompt: the BEST all-around build for a typical game -- adapt to the kit, do not force a split.

definitions.label: Adaptive
definitions.description: Best build specifically against the selected enemy team.
definitions.prompt: the BEST build specifically against the supplied enemy team -- adapt damage, penetration, defenses, boots, and utility to the matchup.

definitions.label: Glass cannon
definitions.description: Maximum overall damage with minimal defensive investment.
definitions.prompt: MAXIMUM DAMAGE (glass cannon): the highest-damage five items THIS kit can actually convert, offense over defense. Convert is the operative word -- an item is only damage if the kit's ratios, cast pattern and attack pattern make use of it. Do not buy a stat the champion cannot express just because the number on it is large.

definitions.label: Crit
definitions.description: Critical-strike scaling and high basic-attack damage.
definitions.prompt: CRIT: 4+ of the 5 items must grant Critical Rate, and no lethality. Crit only applies to what can crit -- if this champion's ABILITIES cannot crit, the build improves basic attacks only, so weight it toward a kit that attacks often enough for that to matter.

definitions.label: Sustained DPS
definitions.prompt: sustained damage-per-second for extended fights, built the way THIS kit sustains damage -- attack speed and on-hit only if the kit actually converts them (not on reload/magazine or caster kits).

definitions.label: On-hit
definitions.description: Attack speed plus effects triggered by repeated attacks.
definitions.prompt: ON-HIT: stack attack speed and on-hit effects, which only works on a kit that applies on-hit repeatedly. A champion who applies one empowered attack per rotation is NOT an on-hit champion, and reload or magazine kits convert attack speed poorly. If this champion cannot stack on-hit, say so rather than forcing the build.

definitions.label: Burst
definitions.description: Maximum damage in a short ability or attack combo.
definitions.prompt: BURST: delete a priority target in one rotation, built around the damage THIS kit actually front-loads. Penetration matters more than raw damage once the target has resistances, and a kit whose damage arrives over several seconds is not made bursty by buying burst items -- if this champion cannot kill inside one rotation, say so and build the closest honest thing.

definitions.label: One-shot
definitions.description: Squishy-target deletion, accepting very low durability.
definitions.prompt: ONE-SHOT: kill a squishy target instantly from a committed engage. Lethality/magic penetration and raw damage over sustain, built around the exact rotation THIS kit uses to open -- the items must be live at the moment that rotation lands.

definitions.label: Split-push / Duelist
definitions.description: Side-lane dueling, wave pressure, and structure damage.
definitions.prompt: SPLIT-PUSH / DUELIST: win side-lane 1v1s and take structures fast, built the way THIS kit duels. Dueling sustain, tower damage and escape all count; which of them to weight depends on whether this champion wins a duel through sustained damage, a burst window, or simply outliving the opponent.

definitions.label: Mobile DPS
definitions.description: Keep dealing damage while moving and staying hard to catch.
definitions.prompt: KITING: keep dealing damage while staying out of reach. Movement, attack range and slows are the tools, and survivability only counts here when it keeps you ATTACKING rather than merely alive. Judge each item by whether it lets this specific kit keep damaging while retreating.

definitions.label: Sustain
definitions.description: Lifesteal or omnivamp for healing through fights.
definitions.prompt: SUSTAIN: survive extended fights by out-healing the damage taken, built the way THIS kit actually heals. Lifesteal and physical vamp are BASIC-ATTACK stats and are only the answer for a champion whose damage comes from attacking; a caster sustains through omnivamp/spell vamp, healing amplification, or enough durability that its own kit healing keeps up. Do not put a lifesteal item on a kit that cannot proc it -- identify how this champion heals first, then buy that. This applies to the RUNE PAGE too: Conqueror, Fleet Footwork, Grasp of the Undying, Legend: Bloodline, Second Wind and Revitalize are all sustain, and a page that ignores the request has answered half of it.

definitions.label: Anti-tank
definitions.description: Percent-health damage and penetration against frontlines.
definitions.prompt: ANTI-TANK: melt a high-Health frontline. %max-HP damage and the penetration type THIS champion's damage actually uses -- armor penetration is worthless on a magic-damage kit and vice versa. Check the champion's damage type before choosing the penetration.

definitions.label: Tanky / Durable
definitions.description: Prioritize survival while remaining useful or threatening.
definitions.prompt: DURABLE: stay alive and remain a threat, built the way THIS kit converts durability into damage. Some kits scale damage directly off Health or resistances and want those stats outright; others get nothing from them and stay dangerous only by surviving long enough to keep casting. Decide which this champion is before choosing between raw resistances, Health, and defensive items with offensive passives.

definitions.label: Poke
definitions.description: Long-range damage and pressure from safety.
definitions.prompt: POKE: repeatable long-range pressure before committing, built so the pressure can be REPEATED -- ability haste and the resource to keep casting matter as much as raw damage, because a poke build that casts twice and stops is not a poke build.

definitions.label: Utility
definitions.description: Ally protection, team value, and supportive effects.
definitions.prompt: UTILITY: ally value over personal damage, delivered the way THIS kit delivers it. A shield/heal enchanter wants heal-and-shield power and the stats its abilities scale from; a lockdown or engage champion provides utility through crowd control and needs to survive long enough to land it. Both are utility builds and they share almost no items, so identify which one this champion is.

_noPokeNote: Champions for whom a Poke build is not offered, classified by scripts/classify_range.py. This is NOT the same as being melee: Lillia, Thresh, Rakan and Vladimir all have ranged basic attacks and still belong here, because they fight at short range and almost none of their damage comes from long range. Champions the classifier was not confident about are also listed: an unsure answer does not get to advertise a build the player may not be able to execute. Poke is filtered out for everyone on this list.
_pokeConfirmedNote: Owner-confirmed Poke champions. Outranks the melee gate and the noPoke list. Rell is here despite being a melee Tank, which is also why she needs an entry in `overrides` below: the Tank class list has no Poke entry, so confirming her eligible is not on its own enough to put Poke in her menu.
